description: This file defines the class tlvProfile2AssociationStatusNotification, which models a TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure related to association status notifications in a Wi-Fi management context. It includes enums, data structures, and methods for handling association status notifications, specifically BSSID-based association allowance statuses.

classes.name: tlvProfile2AssociationStatusNotification
classes.description: A class representing a TLV for association status notifications, including methods for parsing, serialization, and managing a list of BSSID statuses.

methods.description: Constructs the object from a buffer or shared pointer, with optional parsing.

methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: bssid_status_list_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the BSSID status list.

methods.name: bssid_status_list
